mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_login ( user_id, user_type, login_id, client_ip, user_agent, result, fail_reason, session_id, logged_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userType}, #{loginId}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{result}, #{failReason}, #{sessionId}, COALESCE(#{loggedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.sql: log_login_id, user_id, user_type, login_id, client_ip, user_agent, result, fail_reason, session_id, logged_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at

WHERE logged_at >= #{search.dateFrom} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{search.dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND ( login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR client_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR result LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR fail_reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM log_login
ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT #{search.pageSize} OFFSET #{search.offset}
SELECT FROM log_login WHERE log_login_id = #{id} LIMIT 1
